name: B10-0451/2026 (Renew) – The cases of Ali Karimli, Anar Mammadli and other political prisoners in Azerbaijan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the cases of Ali Karimli, Anar Mammadli and other political prisoners in Azerbaijan
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of two jailed opposition figures in Azerbaijan, Ali Karimli and Anar Mammadli. It says Karimli's detention conditions are so bad they may amount to torture, and that Mammadli's trial was politically motivated. It asks Azerbaijan to free all political prisoners, treat detainees properly and allow independent investigations. It also wants the European Union to consider sanctions on officials responsible for serious human rights violations, and to make any future partnership agreement with Azerbaijan depend on human rights improvements. This is the Parliament's opinion; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament demands the release of Karimli and Mammadli and better treatment for all detainees in Azerbaijan.
- It affects the Azerbaijani authorities, jailed critics and the European Union's relations with Azerbaijan.
- Next, the resolution goes to European Union governments and officials, who decide whether to act on it.
